title: Houthi drone debris kills Yemeni resident in Saudi Arabia’s Taif
description: RIYADH: A Yemeni resident was killed and two people injured on Thursday after debris from a Houthi drone fell in Taif after it was intercepted and destroyed, Saudi Arabia’s Civil Defense said. A female Saudi citizen and a Pakistani resident were injured, with the Pakistani national in critical condition. The falling debris also caused material damage to several buildings and vehicles, the government agency said.

title: Libya arrests pilots accused of flying Turkish jet drunk before runway crash
description: Two pilots have been arrested in Libya for allegedly operating a private jet under the influence of alcohol, leading to a crash at Misrata airport. No casualties were reported during the incident.

title: Ireland to boycott Eurovision 2027 over Gaza
description: Ireland has announced it will not participate in the Eurovision Song Contest 2027, citing the ongoing conflict in Gaza. This decision follows a similar boycott in 2026 and aligns with recent actions by other countries.

title: From land to race laws: what’s driving the US-South Africa rift?
description: The US has imposed visa restrictions on South African officials due to perceived discrimination against white populations, marking increased tensions between the nations. This move could lead to more severe measures as part of a worsening diplomatic relationship.

title: Serbia’s President Vucic inaugurates assembly factory for Israel-made drones
description: Serbia’s President Aleksandar Vucic has opened an assembly factory for Israeli drones, marking a significant military advancement. The factory is expected to employ around 100 people and enhance Serbia’s military capabilities.

title: Vance pledges to help airman’s widow after online backlash exposed benefit gaps
description: After Air Force Maj. Alex Klinner died in a KC-135 crash during operations against Iran, his wife Libby struggled to receive some combat-related benefits.

title: Ukraine’s F-16s are being worn out from intercepting Russian drones
description: Ukrainian F-16s have destroyed more than 2,500 one-way attack drones, but repeated interceptions are wearing out the country's small fleet.

title: Germany sending fighter jets to Latvia to protect election from drone incidents
description: Germany will send four Eurofighter jets to defend Latvian airspace during upcoming elections, amid concerns over drone incursions from Russia and Belarus.
